summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** ## ** Petition No. 382/TT/2025 ** **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** **Date of Order: 02.09.2026** ## **In the matter of:** Corrigendum to the order dated 24.3.2026 in Petition No. 382/TT/2025. ## **And In the matter of:** Petition under Sections 62 and 79(1)(d) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Chapter 3, Regulation 13 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 for the truing up of the Annual Fixed Charges for the 2019-24 tariff period and Chapter 3, Regulations 9(2) and 10 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 for the determination of the tariff for the 2024-29 tariff period respect of the New Transmission and Distribution Asset/Elements added in between 1.4.2014 to 31.3.2019 with Transmission and Distribution asset of Damodar Valley Corporation. ## **And In the matter of:** **Damodar Valley Corporation,** DVC Towers, VIP Road, Kolkata. ** Petitioner** ## **Versus** **1. West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited,** (Previously West Bengal State Electricity Board), Block ;DJ’, Sector-11, Salt Lake City, Kolkata-700091. **2. Jharkhand Bijli Vitran Nigam Limited,** (Previously Jharkhand State Electricity Board), Engineering Building, HEC, Dhurwa, Ranchi-834004. **..Respondents** Corrigendum to Order in Petition No. 382/TT/2025 _Page_ **_1_** _of_ **_2_** ## ** CORRIGENDUM ORDER ** Certain inadvertent errors have crept into the Commission’s order dated 24.3.2026 in Petition No. 382/TT/2025, and these errors are corrected/rectified as follows, in exercise of the powers under Regulation 54 read with Regulation 66 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023. Accordingly, after paragraph 98, paragraphs 98A and 98B shall be added: ## “ ** Filing Fee and Publication Expenses ** 98A. The Petitioner has sought reimbursement of the fee it paid for filing the Petition and of publication expenses. The Petitioner shall be entitled to reimbursement of the filing fees and publication expenses in connection with the present Petition, directly from the beneficiaries, on a pro rata basis, in accordance with Regulation 94(1) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. ## ** License Fee and RLDC Fees and Charges ** 98B. The Petitioner shall be entitled to reimbursement of the licence fee in accordance with Regulation 94(4) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the 202429 tariff period. The Petitioner shall also be entitled to the recovery of the RLDC fee and charges in accordance with Regulation 94(3) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the 2024-29 tariff period.” 2. Except for the above, all other terms contained in the order dated 24.3.2026 in Petition No. 382/TT/2025 shall remain unaltered. **sd/- sd/- sd/- sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.)
